findings.title: NCC Group Monthly Threat Pulse - Review of September
findings.summary_md: NCC Group's Q3 review is the report the Qilin unmasking article cites for its victim count. It records Qilin as the most active threat group of the quarter with 365 attacks, edging out The Gentlemen at 359, and notes ransomware rose 23% in Q3 over Q2 while September attacks fell 26% month-on-month to 821. Industrials was the most targeted sector with over 838 attacks in Q3.

findings.title: NCC Group Monthly Threat Pulse - Review of June 2026
findings.summary_md: NCC Group's Q2 report already flagged Qilin as the most active ransomware group, responsible for 14% of Q2 attacks and 12% (79) in June. Global ransomware rose 3% quarter-on-quarter to 2,229 attacks, with industrials the top-targeted sector at 30% for the quarter.

findings.title: NCC Group Monthly Threat Pulse - Review of April 2026
findings.summary_md: NCC Group's April review again named Qilin the most prolific ransomware operator, with industrials the most targeted sector at 28% of recorded attacks and North America the most impacted region. The monthly cadence shows Qilin's dominance was established well before the November unmasking.

findings.title: NCC Group Monthly Threat Pulse - Review of February 2026
findings.summary_md: NCC Group's February review recorded Qilin as the most active threat group, responsible for 15% of all attacks that month. Industrials was the most targeted sector at 31% of ransomware attacks in February 2026.
